title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at Block 1025, Lots 18 & 19, Northeast Corner of US Route 9 South and Main Street in the Township of Middle, County of Cape May, New Jersey, as the "George Henry White Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at Block 1025, Lots 18 & 19, Northeast Corner of U.S. Route 9 South and Main Street in the Township of Middle, County of Cape May, New Jersey, as the George Henry White Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Postal Service facility in Middle Township, New Jersey, as the George Henry White Post Office Building.
summary.what_it_does: This act names a United States Postal Service building in the Township of Middle, Cape May County, New Jersey, as the George Henry White Post Office Building. The building is located at the northeast corner of U.S. Route 9 South and Main Street. The law changes only the official name of the building and does not address its operations, staffing, or services.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
